name: AITemplate
description_en: AITemplate is a Python framework which renders neural network into high performance CUDA/HIP C++ code. Specialized for FP16 TensorCore (NVIDIA GPU) and MatrixCore (AMD GPU) inference.
readme_excerpt: AITemplate AITemplate (AIT) is a Python framework that transforms deep neural networks into CUDA (NVIDIA GPU) / HIP (AMD GPU) C++ code for lightning-fast inference serving. AITemplate highlights include: - High performance: close to roofline fp16 TensorCore (NVIDIA GPU) / MatrixCore (AMD GPU) performance on major models, including ResNet, MaskRCNN, BERT, VisionTransformer, Stable Diffusion, etc. - Unified, open, and flexible.
